results.title: The Night of Samhain
results.overview: Samhain in ancient Ireland, a young boy makes his first mask to hide from wandering spirits, but his family’s supper is interrupted by a visitor from the Otherworld.

results.title: What Life Can Be
results.overview: Celebrating love, connection and the life that’s possible when we look beyond assumptions and limitations.

results.title: I Fell, Remembering You
results.overview: In her final days before leaving the country, a young girl spends time with her brother learning how to ride a bike.

results.title: My Home: The Twiggs
results.overview: When a group of high school friends get entangled in a ploy to steal back the car of a college drop out, they are forced to notice the important details of friendship and growing up.

results.title: The Wait
results.overview: On the morning of their final IVF attempt, a queer Caribbean couple is transported from a sterile waiting room into ancestral portals of love, lineage, and healing.

results.title: Xianglian's Room
results.overview: Three children return home to visit their dying mother. The siblings argue endlessly over whether to remove life support, the inheritance, and matters of faith.

results.title: Aftermath
results.overview: A massacre survivor and a filmmaker form an unlikely bond as they slip down the rabbit hole of paranoia, in a desperate search for solace and truth.

results.title: The Forbidden Aunt
results.overview: An actress documents her enigmatic Serbian aunt's story, revealing family secrets and personal history in a dark comedy exploring female trauma across generations.

results.title: Simon. The Conqueror!
results.overview: The world's greatest detective enters into the town of New Babel. Only to be faced with a grand mystery that only he could conquer... Maybe.

results.title: Carrerilla
results.overview: A young waiter goes through his daily routine, shaped by haste, indifference, and a sense of disconnection from the world around him. Throughout the day, a series of small encounters: at work, on the street, and within his own community; reveal his inability to truly engage with the people around him.

results.title: Yoshi
results.overview: A disillusioned young man contends with the 21st century.

results.title: Intoxication
results.overview: During a remote houseboat bachelor party on Shasta Lake, a groom and his best man tangle with a shadowy New Age cult, only to inadvertently summon an ancient entity into their beer keg, turning their getaway into a floating nightmare.

results.title: Moral
results.overview: Moral is a quiet family drama set during Lucía’s birthday. Natalia is preparing a simple celebration when her estranged partner, Roberto, unexpectedly returns after years of absence.  His arrival disrupts the fragile atmosphere, bringing unresolved history and tension back into the home. As the day unfolds, Natalia is forced to navigate the emotional weight of the past while trying to protect the moment for her daughter.  Seen through Lucía’s innocent perspective, the story explores the silent fractures within a family and the lingering impact of absence, memory, and unspoken choices.

results.title: Going for Home
results.overview: After the devastating Eaton Canyon fire leaves families displaced, a Little League team becomes an unlikely anchor—carrying a fractured community through loss, recovery, and an improbable season.

results.title: Stars on the Ceiling
results.overview: On the war's anniversary, a Ukrainian woman in Toronto must choose between her fiancé's family or supporting her war-displaced niece.

results.title: Kiwi Food
results.overview: Aboard Orbit International Rail, Phileas outruns his roots that hold him back, but with every passing landscape, he's pulled closer to the question he can't escape: where in the world does he truly belong?

results.title: Siesta
results.overview: Conchita, a young woman unable to escape her constant exhaustion, embarks on a journey between dream and reality through a deserted Granada to confront herself and finish the Cruz de Mayo in time for the festivities.

results.title: Limbung
results.overview: In his old age, Lazuardi, a former detective who raised a vampire child as atonement for his sins, is faced with the reopening of his old case, while the vampire child started to feel distant.
